page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highcpu-192 is a compute-optimized server instance featuring 192 vCPUs and 360 GB of RAM. Powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9B45 processor, it contains 96 physical cores with multithreading enabled at 2.0 threads per core. The CPU allocation is fully dedicated, supported by an L3 cache of 32 MB, L2 cache of 1.0 MB, and L1d cache of 48 KB. This instance does not include local storage or onboard GPUs, and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data places this server in the top tier (top 10%) across multiple performance dimensions. It demonstrates high multi-core processing capabilities, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 328,676.05 and a Passmark CPU score of 152,624.84. Memory performance is also in the top tier, delivering a read-only large block bandwidth of 517.96 GB/sec and a write large block bandwidth of 225.4 GB/sec. Cryptographic and vector execution are accelerated by hardware flags including AVX-512, VAES, and SHA_NI, resulting in top-tier performance in Passmark encryption and extended instruction tests.

Given its high compute density and relatively low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1.88 GB per core, the instance is structured for compute-bound workloads rather than memory-heavy databases. It achieves top-tier results in static web serving throughput at 145.85 GB/sec, Redis SET operations at 274.27 million operations per second, and software compilation. It is also capable of handling medium-sized LLM inference tasks, processing 7B model prompts at 450.06 tokens per second. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this instance as a cost-efficient choice for pure CPU-intensive parallel processing, high-throughput web serving, and scientific simulations.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highcpu-192 is a compute-optimized server configured with 192 vCPUs and 360 GB of RAM. It is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9B45 x86_64 processor with 96 physical cores and multithreading. Lacking local storage and GPUs, this instance focuses resources entirely on raw CPU execution and memory bandwidth. Benchmarks place its multi-core CPU performance, encryption capabilities, and memory bandwidth in the top 10% tier, with large-block read bandwidth reaching 517.96 GB/sec. It features advanced instruction support including AVX-512 and VAES. This hardware profile is highly suited for parallel processing, software compilation, high-throughput web serving, and medium-scale LLM inference.
